read.thesis: Supply-side tightening: ASML now says planned 2027–28 supply will not meet demand and is weighing more 2028 capacity beyond the 30% step-up, with Q3 sales €11.7bn and FY26 guide €44–45bn.

capex.quote: we are investigating ways to increase capacity for 2028 beyond the 30% increase we previously communicated

triggers.label: 2028 capacity above prior 30% step-up
triggers.quote: we are investigating ways to increase capacity for 2028 beyond the 30% increase we previously communicated

triggers.label: Supply short of demand for 2027–28
triggers.quote: our supply as currently planned for both 2027 and 2028 will not fully meet the demand of our customers

triggers.label: Q4 sales guide €14.2–15.2bn
triggers.quote: We expect fourth-quarter 2026 total net sales between €14.2 billion and €15.2 billion, with a gross margin around 57%

triggers.label: Customers asking for 2029–30 orders
triggers.quote: some customers are expressing an interest in placing orders with us for 2029 and even 2030

guidance.quote: We expect fourth-quarter 2026 total net sales between €14.2 billion and €15.2 billion
We expect total net sales for 2026 to be between €44 billion and €45 billion
We expect R&D costs of around €1.2 billion and SG&A costs of around €0.4 billion
